en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4377 - The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) stood up to deliver a sermon and said: "O people, beware of the green growth in a dung heap."

It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), what is the green growth in a dung heap?"
He (sw) replied: "A beautiful woman raised in a bad environment."
